title: Promo ad
summary: Turn your product or service into a short promo that drives action.
description: Reach your audience with a gripping opening, an authentic demo and a clear call to action. Using the product photos, videos or descriptions you have, highlight real benefits and lead viewers to buy, sign up or get in touch.
brief: Make a short promo for {{product or service}}. The goal is to {{desired action}}, and the audience is {{audience}}. Materials: {{materials on hand}}.

fields.label: desired action
fields.hint: Pick just one action: buy, sign up or get in touch
fields.example: get new users to sign up for a free trial class

fields.label: audience
fields.hint: Who will see it, and what they care about
fields.example: office workers who want to exercise at home

fields.label: materials on hand
fields.hint: Attached product photos, videos or descriptions; write "none" if you have none
fields.example: the course description and a few class videos

beats: Name the problem the audience cares about
